Good news: your kit is saved. Whether it was a serious design session or a quick look at what's possible, you can pick it up right where you left off.
And when you're ready, you won't finish it alone — before production, a MOMUTO designer reviews every order and cleans up every crest and logo so it prints perfectly. It's how hundreds of teams around the world already got their kits. You're in good hands.
On price: it depends on quantity — from 10 kits, jerseys are €21.90 each. Want the full list by quantity? See it here.
data.bottom_html_oss_bucket: Questions, doubts, a detail to check? Reply to this email — a real person answers.
data.email_title: Your kit is saved — and in good hands
